## Overview

LRP-CA-001 is the first model of the **concurrent conditional-associations** family
(#312, descriptive-association workstream #314). At each timepoint (t1–t4) it fits a
between-child Beta-Binomial regression of **word reading's level** on the standardised
same-wave logits of a core skill set — letter sounds (`L`), blending (`B`), taught
receptive (`TR`) and expressive (`TE`) vocabulary, and receptive (`R`) and expressive
(`E`) vocabulary — plus age and a group nuisance term. The four waves are fitted
separately and reported side by side.

The estimand is the mutually-adjusted association at each wave: *"at wave t, among
children alike on age and the other skills, +n of a predictor skill is associated with
+m more words read"*. No model in the rest of the suite estimates this — the
level-factors family deliberately omits cross-skill terms to protect the causal reading
of its group×time contrast, but that objection does not apply to a family that makes
**no causal claim at all**. All children are on the intervention from t2, so these
describe the conditional joint distribution of the skill measures within a treated
system.

_Estimand: descriptive association (no causal warrant)._ Every coefficient is an **adjusted association**. Conditioning on contemporaneous (post-treatment) skill levels is intentional and licensed *because nothing here is read causally*. Read the results with the Table-2-fallacy, measurement-error and collinearity/regularisation caveats set out in the Results section.
